segments.cap: Integrations → Google Ads for North Carolina Legal Services: Disconnect, then Connect Google Ads
Google account chooser (other accounts on this browser blurred) → paulchrisluke@gmail.com
Google consent for client 799728932262-…: unverified-app notice, then "Krabiclaw wants access"
The requested scope: "See, edit, create, and delete your Google Ads accounts and data" (adwords)
Back in KrabiClaw: pick North Carolina Legal Services (649-529-3607) → Connected
Insights → Google Ads: spend, clicks, impressions, conversions for the last 30 days
Campaigns by spend, read live from the Google Ads account
Range change to 7 days: totals and campaigns re-read from Google Ads
Today: the account's last 7 complete days, linking to that range in Insights
Write, shown on a Business plan organization (Cedar Legal) connected to 649-529-3607; the reporting scenes use the same scope
In ChatGPT, the KrabiClaw app is asked to create a PAUSED Search campaign at $1/day
KrabiClaw creates it through the Google Ads API: PAUSED, $1.00/day, campaign 24374373282
Change made in KrabiClaw: daily budget $1 → $2, still paused
Write: changes reflected in the Google Ads account — $2.00/day
Demo campaign removed in Google Ads (Edit → Remove → Confirm)
KrabiClaw lists the account's campaigns again: the existing five, unchanged; the demo campaign is gone
Cedar Legal disconnected from Google Ads
Plan and billing → Managed ads: KrabiClaw staff manage campaigns in the customer's account under a recorded agreement

segments.html:
Google Ads exposes one OAuth scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords

Reporting and campaign management both require it.

Tokens are stored and refreshed by Better Auth.

Disconnect removes the account from KrabiClaw and stops every Google Ads call; the grant can be revoked at myaccount.google.com/permissions. North Carolina Legal Services ends connected.
